spec.title: Product Category Attributes — Product/Opportunity contexts
spec.goal: Extend the existing Product Category attribute system so the same attribute catalogue can be surfaced in TWO distinct usage contexts, configured as two separate sections in the category config page: - "Attributi Prodotto" -> loaded in the Product card (create/edit). - "Attributi Opportunita'" -> loaded in the Opportunity preliminary info (UNCHANGED). Reuse the current architecture (Attribute catalogue + attribute_category pivot + CategoryHierarchy effective-attributes resolution). No duplication of the attribute model.
spec.hard-invariant: The Opportunity path MUST remain behaviorally identical. All attributes assigned today are Opportunity attributes; the migration backfills every existing attribute_category row to context = 'opportunity'. ApplicableAttributesResolver, OpportunityResource, RequestManagement work-panel and its tests keep producing the same output. Any regression there is a failure.

decisions.d: Two-section model = context DISCRIMINATOR on the pivot. Two independent lists; the same catalogue attribute may be assigned to Product, Opportunity, or both (two pivot rows).

Product attribute VALUES = JSON column products.attribute_values, mirroring opportunities.attribute_values. Reuse AttributeValueValidator / AttributeValueNormalizer. Do NOT recreate the removed product_attribute_values EAV table.

spec.enum: App\Enums\AttributeContext : Product = 'product', Opportunity = 'opportunity'. Default context everywhere = Opportunity (backward compatible).

migrations.m1: Add string column `context` (default 'opportunity') to `attribute_category`. Drop the existing composite unique (attribute_id, category_id) — VERIFY the real index name from 2026_07_07_110300_create_attribute_category_table.php before dropUnique. Add unique (attribute_id, category_id, context). Existing rows keep 'opportunity' via default. down() reverses both (restore old unique). Must be reversible on SQLite + MySQL.
migrations.m2: Add nullable json column `attribute_values` to `products`. down() drops it.

models.ProductCategory: attributes() BelongsToMany: add 'context' to withPivot (keep is_required, sort_order).
models.Product: Add cast 'attribute_values' => 'array'. Keep it OUT of #[Fillable] (mass-assignment guard, same discipline as Opportunity.attribute_values); write it via the service with forceFill. Update the class docblock (it currently states products carry no attribute values).

resolution.CategoryHierarchy: effectiveAttributes(ProductCategory $c, AttributeContext $context = Opportunity) and ancestorAttributes(...) gain a context parameter and filter pivot rows by context. Inheritance / barrier / most-specific-wins logic UNCHANGED, just scoped per context. Default = Opportunity so every current caller is unaffected.
resolution.shared-value-pipeline: Reuse App\RequestManagement\ApplicableAttribute, AttributeValueValidator, AttributeValueNormalizer AS-IS (they are already generic over an attribute collection). Import them from the product path; do NOT duplicate. Do NOT move/rename them (keeps the Opportunity path untouched). New: App\Products\ProductAttributeResolver::resolve(Product) -> Collection built from CategoryHierarchy::effectiveAttributes($product->category, Product).

backend.sync: ProductCategoryService::syncAttributes MUST stop using BelongsToMany::sync() (it keys by attribute_id only and cannot represent the same attribute in two contexts). Replace with a wholesale pivot rewrite for the category: detach all, then insert rows carrying (attribute_id, is_required, sort_order, context). Idempotent, transaction-wrapped.

contract.product-categories: Store/Update payload: attributes[] rows gain `context` in ['product','opportunity'] (required, validated). DTOs carry context. StoreProductCategoryRequest / UpdateProductCategoryRequest rules updated. ProductCategoryResource: each own-attribute row and each inherited-attribute row carries `context`. Shape stays a FLAT list (FE splits by context) — do not nest. Controller keeps merging inherited_attributes + effective_business_function, now context-tagged for both.
contract.effective-attributes: GET product-categories/{productCategory}/effective-attributes?context=product|opportunity Validate context against the enum; default 'opportunity'. Authorization unchanged.
contract.products: Product store/update accept additive `attribute_values`: { attribute_code: value }. Deep validation in ProductService via AttributeValueValidator against the PRODUCT-context effective attributes of the product's category (unknown code / required / per-type rules). Then AttributeValueNormalizer, then forceFill+save. FormRequest does shallow `array` check. ProductResource: additive `attribute_values` + `applicable_attributes` (product context, via ProductAttributeResolver). Envelope { success, message, ... } unchanged.

backend.authz: Existing product-categories.* and products.* policies apply unchanged. No new permissions. Attribute field-level gating mirrors the Opportunity path (MetaField metaKey pattern) — no new server rules beyond what AttributeValueValidator already enforces.
backend.tests: - Backfill/regression: after migration, existing assignments are context='opportunity'; ApplicableAttributesResolver + request-management work-panel output UNCHANGED (assert). - Category sync stores both contexts; effective-attributes endpoint filters by context; inheritance resolves per context (barrier + most-specific still honored). - Product create/update with attribute_values: happy path, unknown code -> 422, missing required -> 422, wrong type -> 422, authz (no permission -> 403). Coverage targets per backend.md. Run Pest for real.

frontend.product-categories: types.ts: add context:'product'|'opportunity' to ProductCategoryAttributeAssignment, ProductCategoryInheritedAttribute, AttributeAssignmentInput, EffectiveAttribute. product-category-schema.ts: attributes[] object gains context. attribute-assignment-editor.tsx: render TWO clearly separated sections/cards ("Attributi Prodotto" / "Attributi Opportunita'") each with its own list (filtered by context), add/remove/is_required/sort_order, and its own inherited read-only list. The picker in each section assigns with that section's context. Compact enterprise style per ui-design.md (small, cards/sections graphically distinct, each with a short description of where the attributes are used). Reuse components/ui + existing sub-parts; keep file under 300/500 limits (split if needed). product-category-form-body.tsx: wire the two sections. api.ts: fetchEffectiveAttributes(categoryId, context) -> ?context=. use-effective-attributes.ts: accept context, include in query key.
frontend.products: New dynamic-fields block in the Product form driven by useEffectiveAttributes(category_id, 'product'). REUSE the proven bridge: the pure adapter toCustomFieldDescriptor (features/request-management/request-attribute-adapter.ts) + CUSTOM_FIELD_COMPONENT_REGISTRY. Map EffectiveAttribute -> descriptor (same rich shape as ApplicableAttribute). Do NOT modify request-management files (Opportunity path untouched): import the pure adapter, or extract a shared component under features/attributes/ that products use and request-management is left as-is. product-form-body.tsx: insert the block (after the category picker; alongside the existing CustomFieldsSection). React to category_id via useWatch; empty when no category. use-product-form.ts / product-schema.ts: dynamic Zod schema + seeded defaults for attribute_values, mirroring buildRequestWorkSchema / seedAttributeValues. product-form-payload.ts: include attribute_values in the create/update payload. types.ts: Product gains attribute_values + applicable_attributes (additive). Product detail: render product attribute values read-only (additive).
frontend.i18n: product-categories namespace: titles + descriptions for the two sections. products namespace: dynamic-fields title/empty. it + en. Respect the 500-line file limit (split a locale file if an addition would exceed it, as done previously).
frontend.tests: Vitest: attribute-assignment-editor two-section behavior; product dynamic fields render + submit attribute_values; effective-attributes context wiring. Run for real.

spec.verification: Pest (products + product-categories + REGRESSION opportunities/request-management), Vitest, tsc -b, Pint, ESLint. The single most important AC: the Opportunity / request preliminary-info path is byte-for-byte unchanged. Report green/red with evidence.
